verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck brush into Cryptic Gaze (Q) or let the lane drag past 10 minutes while Sion's E (Enrage) stacks permanent max HP off kills; you win if you force fights off Infernal Chains (W) and outheal his Enrage trades before his Cannibalism (R) comes online at 6.

brief.thesis: Sion has zero gap-close outside Flash and only a 550-range stun to engage, while Aatrox has a 9/8/7/6/5s dash (E, Umbral Dash) that heals on hit and a passive empowered auto (Deathbringer Stance) that both sustain through Sion's health-cost Enrage swings. That structural mobility and healing gap is why Aatrox holds both the lane and solo-kill advantage in the data, even though the 50.8% head-to-head over 177 games stays close because Sion's permanent HP growth off kills can erase that edge if the lane runs long.

theirWindow.when: Sion stares from an unwarded brush
theirWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze (Q) deals damage and stuns on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown from range 550; don't walk minion-deep near his jungle entrances or tribrush without vision once he hits level 3-4 and prioritizes Q.

yourWindow.when: Right after you land W (Infernal Chains)
yourWindow.what: Immediately chain Q and E while he's forced to sprint out of the impact radius or get dragged back for double damage; he has no dash to contest this, so this is your best forced-trade window all lane.

powerCurve.note: Both champs weak, minimal trading early.
Darkin Blade (Q) ranks up, you pressure hard.
World Ender (R) online, huge sustained-fight power.
Both fully itemized, measured win rate even.

start.why: 53.4% win rate over 178 games and 79.5% pick rate; the extra sustain and AD trade into Sion's AA-based Enrage poke without overcommitting to the tankier Doran's Shield line.

boots.why: 52.7% win rate over 74 games beats Plated Steelcaps' 48.7%; the tenacity directly cuts the duration of Cryptic Gaze's stun, which is Sion's only real engage tool.

core.why: The highest-pick core path (13.5% pick, 47.1% WR starts here); the shield proc and omnivamp let you tank through Enrage autos while you burst him down.
On-hit healing and the proc reward you for landing empowered autos mid-combo, extending fights in your favor against his health-cost attack speed.
Damage-over-time conversion lets you survive the burst window when Sion dumps Enrage stacks into you, then outheal the leftover damage after the fight.

situational.when: sion stacks a lot of permanent max health off kills and starts shrugging off your burst
you need the extra cooldown haste to chain your all-in combo more often in skirmishes
you want a burst dash to punish his complete lack of mobility before he scales

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing scale directly off extended melee exchanges, which is exactly the attrition race Sion's Enrage/Cannibalism kit wants to force — Conqueror lets you win that race instead of him.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts a noticeably higher measured win rate here (57.3% vs Flash+Ignite's 48.9%) because Sion has no dash and only a 550-range stun, so he can't punish you for TP-splitting or returning with plates; hold Flash to dodge Cryptic Gaze or to close distance the moment his Death's Caress (W) shield drops.

playing.title: Respect his shield before all-in
playing.detail: Death's Caress (W) absorbs damage on an 8s cooldown and explodes outward if left up; bait it down or wait for the detonation before committing your full combo so you aren't dumping damage into a shield that just hits you back.

playing.title: Chain off Infernal Chains
playing.detail: Land W then immediately follow with Q and E while he's forced out of the impact zone or re-pulled for double damage; he has no dash to escape this.

playing.title: Track your Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Hold the passive's empowered auto for trades rather than wasting it on minions, since you need the extra healing to outlast his Enrage-fueled damage race.

playing.title: Ward his engage brush
playing.detail: OP.GG flags Sion using Cryptic Gaze (Q) from brush as his main engage; keep vision on tribrush and jungle entrances once he's level 3-4 and prioritizing Q.

playing.title: Use Q3's knockup to disengage him
playing.detail: Your third Darkin Blade (Q) cast lifts enemies on its edges airborne; use it to interrupt an Enrage-stacked all-in or knock him off minions he's trying to execute for permanent HP.

playing.title: End lane before his HP snowballs
playing.detail: Enrage (E) permanently grows his max health on every unit kill with zero cooldown; force skirmishes and plates early rather than letting the lane stall past 10 minutes.

playing.title: Save E to dodge or punish his stun
playing.detail: Umbral Dash is on the shortest cooldown in your kit (9/8/7/6/5s) and heals on champion damage; use it to sidestep Cryptic Gaze's cast or immediately close distance after he whiffs it.

brief.patchCaveat: All items, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning, trade windows, and timing calls are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s (Q) used from inside a brush. Use [Q] to cast him airborne to easily gain lane control.
